headline: Approved contracts for HVAC maintenance ($25,710), holiday lighting ($26,100), sewer flow study ($34,880.09), and transit operations ($9,789,870)
summary: The Finance Committee approved four contracts: HVAC preventive maintenance for Fire Department facilities, holiday lighting installation in downtown Nashua, a sewer flow metering and capacity analysis for a casino project on Tara Boulevard, and transit operations services. The committee also accepted the Final ACFR for FY25 and confirmed compliance with expenditure records for August 28, 2026 through September 10, 2026.
decisions: Approved a one-year contract with Palmer & Sicard, Inc. for HVAC service and preventive maintenance at Fire Department facilities, not to exceed $25,710
Awarded a contract to New England Holiday Light Company for holiday lighting installation in downtown Nashua, not to exceed $26,100
Awarded a sewer flow metering and capacity analysis contract for a casino project on Tara Boulevard to Hazen and Sawyer P.C., not to exceed $34,880.09
Awarded a transit operations contract to Transdev, Inc. for fixed route and paratransit service, not to exceed $9,789,870
Confirmed the Finance Committee complied with the City Charter and ordinances on the Record of Expenditures for August 28, 2026 through September 10, 2026
